purpose: Canonical COMPANY boundary model for the portfolio (owner-directed 2026-06-06). Consolidates the portfolio/data/identity/integration/deployment boundaries into ONE single source (no-magic-values) read by scripts/check_company_portfolio_boundaries.py. Sits ALONGSIDE architecture/portfolio_dependency_law.json (the import law); the two MUST agree (owned_runtime_surfaces == package_roots; allowed_integrations == may_depend_on) — the proof asserts no contradiction.
principle: Co-located for latency/dev-speed · contract-separated for product clarity · account-separated for security/spinout · data-separated for trust · brand-separated for customer clarity.
located_close_means: private connectivity (PrivateLink / Private Service Connect / VPC peering / mesh — not public internet in prod)
shared identity ROOT + separate service identities (no shared god token)
shared observability SCHEMA (CloudEvents/OTel) + separate telemetry STORES
repo_evolution_phases: Phase 1 (now): monorepo with hard boundaries — src/teleon, src/baltor, src/openharnesshub + the enforced import law
Phase 2: separate packages, same repo — shared-contracts holds NO business logic
Phase 3: separate repos/orgs once the API contracts stabilize (do not rush the split)
